title: On Obtaining permission in writing
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：obtain　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 obtain 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the porter ① obtained permission in writing without complaint, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the porter ② obtains permission in writing with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ obtain permission in writing at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ obtained permission in writing before — a line in the journal for August 1947 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Obtaining permission in writing without complaint, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ obtain no answer to three letters with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Obtain no answer to three letters at once and never mention it again.

By 1960 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new visitor from the next coast ⑧ obtains no answer to three letters without complaint every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cove, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ obtained permission in writing again when nobody else would.

⑩ To obtain permission in writing, my mother said in 1965, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the coast remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the coast forgets, somebody obtains permission in writing with great care again and somebody must obtain permission in writing without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 获得（一般过去式 obtained permission in writing：1953 年挑夫头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 获得（一般现在 obtains permission in writing：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 获得（不定式 to obtain permission in writing：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 获得（过去完成时 had obtained permission in writing：1947 年八月的行记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 获得（动名词 obtaining permission in writing 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 得到（obtain no answer to three letters：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去得到三封信都没得到回音）
G. v. 得到（obtain no answer to three letters：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 获得（后段两处：新来的游客照例 obtains no answer to three letters，而母亲又一次 obtained permission in writing）

items.q: obtain no answer to three letters with great care
obtain no answer to three letters at once
obtains no answer to three letters without complaint

answers.why: obtain 意为“获得”，1953 年挑夫毫无怨言地获得拿到了书面许可，那是海岸里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 obtained。
obtain 意为“获得”，自那以后挑夫小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 obtains。
obtain 意为“获得”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯获得拿到了书面许可”，此处为不定式 to obtain permission in writing。
obtain 意为“获得”，行记里 八月 那行字说明早在 1960 年之前就有人获得过，故用过去完成时 had obtained。
obtain 意为“获得”，挑夫说“获得拿到了书面许可这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 obtaining permission in writing 作主语。
obtain 意为“得到”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去得到三封信都没得到回音”，should ever 之后用原形 obtain no answer to three letters。
obtain 意为“得到”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻得到三封信都没得到回音（obtain no answer to three letters at once），以后再也不要提起。
obtain 意为“获得”，新来的游客每个星期都照例得到三封信都没得到回音，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 obtains。
obtain 意为“获得”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地获得拿到了书面许可，用一般过去式 obtained 叙述。
obtain 意为“获得”，结尾那句是母亲 1965 年的话：要获得拿到了书面许可，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和海岸记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1953 年，挑夫毫无怨言地获得拿到了书面许可；海岸里每一个游客都说这是头一回。（obtained permission in writing）
多年以后，挑夫仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（obtains permission in writing）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯获得拿到了书面许可这件事本身。（to obtain permission in writing）
早在 1947 年就有人获得拿到了书面许可，八月那天行记上的一行字就是证据。（had obtained permission in writing）
挑夫说过，毫无怨言地获得拿到了书面许可这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（obtaining permission in writing 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻得到三封信都没得到回音，以后再也不要提起。（obtain no answer to three letters，祈使句）
answers: In 1953 the porter obtained permission in writing without complaint, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the porter still obtains permission in writing with great care without being asked.
My mother said later that to obtain permission in writing at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had obtained permission in writing long before 1960, and the line in the journal for August proves it.
Obtaining permission in writing without complaint, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Obtain no answer to three letters at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 obtain 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the porter obtained permission in writing without complaint, and nobody in the coast forgot it.
Even now the porter obtains permission in writing with great care whenever the coast asks.
Obtaining permission in writing without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever obtain no answer to three letters with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next coast obtains no answer to three letters without complaint every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother obtained permission in writing again, and the coast remembered that half.
